notes: New in 1.4.15: films whose sound is Dolby (AC-3 / E-AC-3), DTS or MP2 are no longer silent - the player now decodes them itself where the phone cannot. Films in 10-bit H.265 that stopped with 'Playback failed' on phones without the hardware for them now open in a compatibility player (VLC) instead; the normal player is still used whenever it can play the film. Settings > About lists the open-source licences. The app is larger because it now carries these decoders.
